title: Trump’s integration policies build on Gulf, Turkey ties and Syria success
gist: Andrew Parasiliti argues that the headline US-Iran confrontation obscures a historic Gulf-led effort to integrate the Gulf and the Levant economically, an opportunity opened by Syria's transition from Bashar al-Assad to Ahmad al-Sharaa and building on the Gulf's development-driven model; Iran's influence and risk of renewed conflict complicate progress in Iraq.

insights.claim: The escalating US-Iran confrontation is overshadowing a less-noticed but historic effort to integrate the Gulf and the Levant into a more prosperous and interconnected Middle East.
insights.speaker: Andrew Parasiliti
insights.so_what: Investors focused on US-Iran conflict risk may be underpricing the regional integration/investment story — and conversely, escalation is the main threat to it.
